neighbours.label: preposition linking a group of people to the institution or place they belong to ('academics based at universities', 'bands from any era')
fire: The conference brought together engineers employed at software firms across Europe.
Our reviewers, most of whom are lecturers based at colleges, volunteer their time.
The anthology collects poems by writers from the Caribbean and West Africa.
The petition was signed by nurses working in hospitals around the state.
Volunteers recruited from local churches helped serve the meals.
The survey covered farmers living in villages along the river.
She interviewed musicians from bands of every decade since the sixties.
Grants go to researchers based at institutions in developing countries.
quiet: The conference brought together engineers to talk about software design.
Our reviewers volunteer their time and receive no payment for it.
The anthology collects poems about the sea, love, and grief.
The petition was signed by thousands of nurses last month.
Volunteers helped serve the meals and clean the kitchen afterward.
The survey asked farmers about rainfall, prices, and debt.
She interviewed musicians about how they write their songs.
Grants go to young researchers who propose bold projects.

notes: Weak pole (max 7.7, 35% echo regime). Probe: 'scientists based at hospitals' 0.24, others <0.15; expected to fail.
